title: Group named fields
summary: Julia: Group named fields. Make another Book value.
introduction: A struct defines a type with named fields. Ordinary structs are immutable.

blocks.text: Install Julia. Save each example as lesson.jl and run julia lesson.jl, or paste it into the Julia REPL.

blocks.title: Group named fields
blocks.code:
struct Book
 title::String
 pages::Int
end
book = Book("Moon Trip", 24)
println(book.pages)

blocks.text: The Book constructor stores 24 in pages. Dot access reads it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use mutable struct only when fields really need changing.
